title: 麦格理Ellie Jiang：美国监管压力下，中国AI全栈战略能否持续？
speaker: Ellie Jiang

segments.en: Do you think when it comes to the US regulatory side of things, is the tightness scrutiny still going to be the biggest overhang?
segments.zh: 你认为在美国监管方面，严格的审查仍将是最大的隐患吗？

segments.en: When it comes to some of these hyperscores that you talked about here, despite, you know, if NVIDIA has Jens Huang or not?
segments.zh: 谈到你提到的这些超大规模企业，尽管，你知道，英伟达是否有黄仁勋？

segments.en: Well, it's not about Jens and Huang or not. It's more about how, well, there are two things.
segments.zh: 嗯，这与黄仁勋无关。更多的是关于，嗯，有两件事。

segments.en: How is China viewing the entire AI stacks development going forward? And the answer is pretty simple, that China definitely is committed to continue investing in AI.
segments.zh: 中国如何看待整个AI技术栈的未来发展？答案很简单，中国肯定致力于继续**AI。

segments.en: They want quality growth. So eventually, the country is trying to manage the pace of the development.
segments.zh: 他们想要高质量增长。所以最终，国家正试图管理发展节奏。

segments.en: For the hyperscalers, of course, they are at the frontier. I mean, most majority of the company that we cover, including Bob on Tencent, they are investing this so-called full-stacks strategy, right, so they have chip, they have, you know, their own cloud, they have their AI frontier models, etc, etc.
segments.zh: 对于超大规模企业来说，当然，他们处于前沿。我的意思是，我们覆盖的大多数公司，包括Bob负责的腾讯，他们都在**所谓的全栈战略，对吧，所以他们有芯片，有，你知道，自己的云，有人工智能前沿模型等等。

segments.en: So eventually, we are still counting on them to drive the next wave of growth or innovation. So I don't think that is changed.
segments.zh: 所以最终，我们仍然指望他们推动下一波增长或创新。所以我不认为这一点改变了。

segments.en: What is changing is, indeed, for the external environments, it's getting a lot more complicated to really assess, right, even from the company's perspective.
segments.zh: 确实在变化的是，外部环境越来越复杂，难以真正评估，对吧，甚至从公司的角度来看也是如此。

segments.en: They are trying to really take a pause and potentially just bring down the numbers for the near term, so that they can have a better view on 2027 before things clear out.
segments.zh: 他们正试图真正暂停一下，可能只是降低近期的数字，以便在情况明朗之前对2027年有更好的看法。

segments.en: So I think we are still weathering through that vacuum period where 27 is where you see domestic stock has yet to catch up, but obviously we are already losing that potential overseas channels in the near term.
segments.zh: 所以我认为我们仍在经历那个真空期，27年是你看到国内库存尚未赶上，但显然我们已经在短期内失去了潜在的海外渠道。

segments.en: How should I be looking at, I mean, you talked about, right, you know, maybe it is the hyperscalers that, you know, fundamentals, I mean, maybe a little bit more sound versus like, I mean, how do you look at the hardware space?
segments.zh: 我该怎么看，你提到过，也许超大规模厂商基本面更稳健一些，那硬件领域你怎么看？
